visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with pigtails and a green t-shirt sits on a light wooden floor. She holds small, crumbly pieces of food in her hands. Beside her is a plush fish toy with a carabiner attached. (2) The girl lies flat on her belly on the floor, crumbling the food bits into a small pile. A white cat with black spots walks behind her, moving under a light-colored office desk with wheels. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with shelves and storage boxes in the background. (3) A close-up shot shows the girl sitting upright again. She touches her bare feet and toes, looking down with a curious expression. (4) An adult woman's hands enter the frame, handing a white, cylindrical handheld vacuum cleaner to the girl. The girl grabs the handle and begins to inspect the device. (5) The girl stands and squats over the floor, pressing the vacuum nozzle against the crumbs. She moves the device back and forth with focused concentration. In the background, adult legs are visible, and another blurred figure stands further away. (6) The girl continues to vacuum the area around the desk leg. She uses both hands to guide the device, then lifts it up to check the floor. Finally, she sits back down, looks at the camera, and then crawls away toward the light-filled window area. (7) The video ends with a pink background and a cartoon logo of a girl.
